sections.heading: Spacious Luxury Boating & Stylish, Intimate Cruising
sections.content:
ASMARATY was founded on a shared passion for design, craftsmanship, and life at sea. Bringing a distinct personality to the water, our boatbuilding journey is united by an emphasis on contemporary aesthetics, generous living spaces, and thoughtful onboard comfort.

With an emphasis on spacious luxury boating and stylish, intimate cruising, our vessels feature broad proportions, expansive main deck saloons, opening sliding panoramic hardtops, and refined Italian fittings. Every model is engineered to be as rewarding to spend time aboard as it is to admire from the shore.

From our flagship G-100 superyacht to our G-66, G-50, and G77 models, ASMARATY continues to set new benchmarks for space, luxury, and uncompromised sea-keeping excellence.

sections.heading: Advanced Vacuum-Infused Composites
sections.description: We utilize multi-axial glass fiber, carbon fiber reinforcements, and high-performance vinylester resins processed via vacuum resin infusion. This achieves optimal strength-to-weight ratios, increased fuel efficiency, higher cruising speeds, and exceptional acoustic insulation.
